textFingerprintsComment: Deterministic license-text identification. Evaluate IN ORDER against text normalized to lowercase with all whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces; a rule matches when every allOf substring is present AND (anyOf is absent or at least one anyOf substring is present). First match wins; no match = null. Two ordering rules, both load-bearing, both regression-tested against the real SPDX texts in licenses.vectors.json: (1) licenses that name other licenses in their own body come first (MPL-2.0 section 1.12 and EPL-2.0 section 1 both name the GNU family as Secondary Licenses, GPL-3.0 section 13 names the AGPL, and the SPDX LGPL-3.0 text appends the whole GPL-3.0 text); (2) supersets come after the stricter license they contain (BSD-3 before BSD-2, ISC before 0BSD, which is ISC minus the copyright-notice condition). Because incidental mentions are unavoidable, GNU-family rules match the title adjacency (name immediately followed by its version) rather than name and version anywhere in the text.
